'''2024 Jawa Cup''' was the Players Committee Jawa Format event on GEMP, 13–25 February 2024. [[Conor Britain]] finished 1st in the published Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-03-jawa-cup-top-8-feb-13-25-on-gemp/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Jawa Format]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 13–25 February 2024
